hotspots.title: November 2010
hotspots.body: The final book was split into two films. Part 1 opened in November 2010, again directed by David Yates.

hotspots.title: A darker music
hotspots.body: Alexandre Desplat took over as composer for the last two films, with a restless, string-driven score for the journey.

hotspots.title: Ice and a sword
hotspots.body: A silver light leads to a frozen pool in the forest. What lies at the bottom has to be fetched by breaking the ice.

hotspots.title: A tent that is bigger inside
hotspots.body: The friends live out of an enchanted tent, roomy and shabby within, small and alone among the trees without.

hotspots.title: A dance in the cold
hotspots.body: In the bleakest stretch of the journey, two friends dance to a song on the radio. It is a moment that is not in the book, and one of the most talked-about in the film.

hotspots.title: A frozen amphitheatre
hotspots.body: The great curved limestone cliff of Malham Cove in Yorkshire stood in for one of the friends' campsites, its strange top of cracked rock pavement seen in the film.

hotspots.title: Seven of him
hotspots.body: In the escape from Privet Drive, six friends take on Harry's appearance. Daniel Radcliffe played each of them in turn, shot separately and combined.

hotspots.title: A story in shadow puppets
hotspots.body: The legend of three brothers who cheat death is told as an animated sequence of shadow-puppet figures, directed by Ben Hibon.

hotspots.title: Plans for 3D, dropped
hotspots.body: The film was planned for a 3D release, but the conversion was abandoned late in the schedule; it opened in 2D only.

hotspots.title: Two nominations
hotspots.body: It was nominated for Academy Awards for art direction and visual effects.

collectibles.name: A portable radio
collectibles.note: Tuned to a station reading out names.

collectibles.name: A deluminator's spark
collectibles.note: A tiny light that wants to go home.
